about: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer based in Toronto, Canada, with over 6 years of expertise building high-performance, resilient, and accessible web applications. Specializing in modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems (React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS) and distributed cloud architectures, I am dedicated to crafting clean code, intuitive user experiences, and scalable solutions that drive measurable business impact.
services: Full-Stack Web Architecture: End-to-end development of high-performance, scalable web applications using Next.js, React, Node.js, and TypeScript.
Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps: Architecting resilient cloud systems, microservices, containerization with Docker, and CI/CD pipelines on AWS.
API Design & Systems Integration: Engineering robust REST and GraphQL APIs with rock-solid security, rate limiting, and seamless third-party integrations.
UI/UX & Performance Optimization: Crafting responsive, accessible, pixel-perfect user interfaces with Tailwind CSS optimized for Core Web Vitals and speed.
skills: Frontend: React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, React Query
Backend: Node.js, Express.js, NestJS, Python, GraphQL, RESTful APIs
Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Prisma ORM, Mongoose
DevOps & Cloud: AWS (S3, EC2, Lambda), Docker, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Vercel
Testing & Quality: Jest, Cypress, Microservices, System Architecture, Clean Code

experience.description:
- Spearheaded the architectural migration of core SaaS platform to Next.js and NestJS, reducing initial load times by 42%.

- Implemented robust RBAC authorization, JWT authentication protocols, and end-to-end Redis caching strategies.
- Mentored 6 distributed software engineers, instituted automated CI/CD pipelines, and boosted test coverage from 55% to 92%.

- Engineered responsive client-facing web applications using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.
- Built real-time collaborative workspace features utilizing WebSockets, reducing synchronization delays by 60%.
- Streamlined database query execution and index optimization, cutting server response bottlenecks by 35%.
- Collaborated closely with product managers and UX teams to deliver 12 major feature rollouts on schedule.

- Developed modular, reusable design system components using React and Tailwind CSS across 4 client portals.
- Enhanced web accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA compliant) and increased mobile engagement metrics by 28%.
- Integrated third-party analytics, payment gateways (Stripe), and transactional email workflows.
